claim: New York City licenses as many yellow cabs as London licenses black cabs
caveat_shown: Both are licence counts. About a fifth of New York City medallions are not currently in service, so fewer yellow cabs work the streets than the cap allows.

claim: New York City runs a Staten Island Ferry that carries as many passengers as all of Sydney's
New York City draws as many museum visitors to the Met as the Uffizi draws in Florence
caveat_shown: Both are multi-site museums: the Met counts Fifth Avenue and the Cloisters, the Uffizi counts the gallery, the Pitti Palace and the Boboli Gardens.

claim: New York City fills as many Broadway seats at home as touring Broadway fills everywhere else
New York City sits at the centre of a region that speaks as many languages as Indonesia
caveat_shown: The 700-plus count covers the whole New York metropolitan area, not the five boroughs, and is a field tally of immigrant and heritage language varieties rather than a census. Indonesia's is distinct living languages.

claim: New York City has as many murders a year as Houston has homicides
caveat_shown: Houston's count is homicides reported to its police. Houston has 2.4 million people to New York City's 8.5 million, so its rate is about three times higher.

claim: New York City answers as many 911 calls a year as all of North Carolina
caveat_shown: New York City's is a fiscal year to June 2025; North Carolina's is calendar 2025.

claim: New York City makes as many arrests a year as Buffalo has people
New York City sends an ambulance as many times a year as Philadelphia has people
